description.zh: 告警事件ID。可调用[DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~)获取告警事件ID，取值路径为：data.SuspEvents[index].UniqueInfo。
description.en: The ID of the alert event. You can call [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~) to obtain the alert event ID. The value is in the data.SuspEvents[index].UniqueInfo path.

description.zh: 告警事件资产UUID，可调用[DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~)获取告资产UUID，取值路径为：data.SuspEvents[index].Uuid。
description.en: The UUID of the asset associated with the alert event. You can call [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~) to obtain the asset UUID. The value is in the data.SuspEvents[index].Uuid path.

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：

- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language type for the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.
The namespace of the graph. Set this parameter to hundun_dc_online.
